🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; positives concentrated in Communication, Consumer Staples, Industrials and Materials while Technology is weak. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); major divergence among large caps (GOOGL, META, JPM, MA)—watch for confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials catching up: FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, UPS (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.25% | 1M: -29.37%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: PYPL (1W: -24.87% | 1M: -33.29%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND; FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND; PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION; CRM (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -27.74%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -12.08% | 1M: -31.03%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -13.53% | 1M: -32.68%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: VZ (1W: +18.31%), CHTR (1W: +16.71%), FDX (1W: +13.76%), PEP (1W: +12.67%), DOW (1W: +12.67%) — all ABOVE TREND. Watch RECOVERY signals in Financials: JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -4.76%) RECOVERY; several big-cap divergences merit tactical caution.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with CORRECTION pockets. AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND coexists with MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +5.38%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.22% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: 3/19 positive — downside risk remains.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed, selective RECOVERY signs but overall soft. JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -4.76%) RECOVERY versus PYPL (1W: -24.87% | 1M: -33.29%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 6/20 positive — look for idiosyncratic setups rather than broad exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively constructive with pockets of leadership. JNJ (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.11%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +9.65% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND while UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND is a notable outlier. Sector breadth: 11/15 positive — defensive and vaccine/therapy catalysts supportive.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to leaders in Communication, Consumer Staples and Industrials (e.g., VZ, PEP, FDX) and reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing structural weakness. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat strength in staples/materials as tactical rather than broad conviction given major-cap divergences. Monitor big-cap corrections for confirmation before adding to core positions.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (Sector breadth: strong), Industrials (Sector breadth: positive). BEARISH: Technology (Sector breadth: 3/19 positive), Financials (watch for dispersion and idiosyncratic moves).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 900 resistance (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim puts tech cap leaders at risk. AAPL 180 support (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND — holds to confirm consumer/tech resilience. JPM 200 breakout (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY — follow-through would validate financials catch-up. MSFT 320 support (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND — breakdown would deepen tech weakness.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MRK (+80): ENFLONSIA approval; MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. CL (+60): margin expansion guide; CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. APD (+55): $140M NASA contracts; APD (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +9.73%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-75): DOJ probe headlines; UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a material downside risk. EL (-65): weak outlook hit; EL (1W: -16.10% | 1M: -10.95%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. PEP (-45): reported price-cut plans; PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND — news diverges from price; monitor for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (GOOGL/META CORRECTIONs vs. JPM/MA RECOVERY) and UNH negative sentiment — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
